newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index ends up on A share gains.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index ends up on A share gains.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index ended up on Friday with domestic buying in line with gains on the A share market, brokers said.
But trading was not active with most overseas investors remaining on the sidelines, waiting for the bulk of the release of the companies' 1996 results due April 30, they said.
The B index edged up 0.218 points or 0.30 percent to 73.494 points on volume of 15.07 million shares worth $8.26 million.
The A index was up 15.937 points or 1.22 percent to 1,321.663 points on turnover of 12.2 billion yuan.
Strong A share performance encouraged domestic investors on the B share market to some extent, but trading was still slow with most institutions remaining sidelined, brokers said.

"Most investors are taking a wait-and-see attitude during the company report season, but market sentiment is good with investors' believing that there are more opportunities to make money on the stock markets this year due to improved market fundamentals," one broker said.
Another broker said technical charts showed the market was still on a slowly rising track.
Of the 43 B shares, 42 traded, with 20 up, six flat and 16 down.
Real estate developer Shanghai Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone Development was the star on domestic buying, up $0.014 or 3.05 percent to $0.472 on volume of 443,000 shares.
Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products was the most actively traded stock on expectations of good results, gaining $0.020 or 2.70 percent to $0.760 on volume of 1.8 million shares.
The Shanghai A share index closed at its highest point since May 5, 1993 on bullish sentiment, but was off its intraday high of 1,331.130 points on profit-taking just ahead of the close.
The index climbed 15.937 points or 1.22 percent to end at 1,321.663 points on volume of 972.5 million shares worth 12.2 billion yuan.
The SSE30 index put on 55.467 points or 1.60 percent to end at 3,523.073 points.
Shanghai Oriental Pearl was the star on expectations of a good bonus issue plan, jumping 2.05 yuan or 10.00 percent to 22.55 yuan on volume of 1.6 million shares.
